title: Service Fee and Change Fee Waiver Entitlements by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
Two waivers attach to a tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club. The agency service fee waiver records whether the agency service fee is waived on bookings made while holding the tier. The waived change fee count is the number of change fees waived each membership year across the portfolio.

## Entitlements by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agency service fee waived | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Change fees waived (each membership year) | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 |

## Reading of the entitlements

The two waivers do not begin at the same tier. The agency service fee waiver begins at Wanderlane Platinum and is carried at Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador as well; at Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver and Wanderlane Gold the agency service fee is not waived.

The waived change fee count begins one tier earlier, at Wanderlane Gold with 1 change fee each membership year, and rises through 2 at Wanderlane Platinum and 4 at Wanderlane Titanium to 8 at Wanderlane Ambassador. At Wanderlane Blue and Wanderlane Silver it stands at 0.
